description: Save a lasting rule from the Developer about how you should work in this project, such as 'ask me before changing the plan'. get_status lists it from then on. Use it only for rules meant to last; a one-off request is just done. A rule the Developer says holds in every project ('in all my projects...', 'always, everywhere...') goes in with global: true: it is saved once for this computer and every project's get_status shows it.

global.description: true for a rule for everything: the Developer says it holds in all their projects ('in all my projects...'). Saved once for this computer; shown wherever Progressor runs.

hard.description: true for a rule that must never be broken (not just a preference); get_status, the session start and get_rules list those first as HARD RULE.

helpers_at_once.description: Makes this rule the project's helper limit: the most Tasks that may be 'with a helper' at once, such as 2 when the Developer says 'at most 2 helpers in parallel'. One rule holds the limit; setting it here takes it off any other. 0 removes it.

text.description: The rule, in the Developer's words where possible.

name: add_standing_instruction
title: Add Standing Instruction
